name: pulse-requirements-analysis
description: Analyzes requirements for React component work in this Laravel Inertia app. Use when a component request needs goals, non-goals, constraints, user workflows, acceptance criteria, edge cases, or behaviour scenarios before implementation.
purpose: Convert the user request into actionable component requirements that can drive architecture, API design, tests, and review.
single_responsibility: Turn the user request into actionable, testable component requirements: goals, non-goals, constraints, workflows, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and behaviour scenarios.
triggers: Acceptance criteria or behaviour scenarios are undefined
Request is broad, ambiguous, or multi-step
Behaviour, accessibility, responsive, animation, or testing expectations need definition
A reusable component API may be introduced or changed

optional: Bug reports, logs, screenshots, or failing tests

completion_criteria: Acceptance criteria are written as observable user outcomes
Edge cases and failure states are named
Assumptions are marked separately from confirmed requirements
Open questions are minimal, concrete, and flagged when they block implementation
validation_criteria: Open questions are minimal and concrete
failure_handling: If the request is too ambiguous to define testable acceptance criteria, stop and report the open questions instead of inventing scope.
Report any requirement left unresolved and whether it blocks implementation.
escalation_path: Escalate scope, priority, or product decisions to the user.
Route uncertain library or framework behaviour to pulse-docs-research.
Hand reusable API implications to pulse-api-contract.
responsibilities: Identify user goals and target workflows.
Write acceptance criteria in user-observable terms.
Identify edge cases and failure states.
Capture explicit device, input, accessibility, and reduced-motion expectations when relevant.
